references.appliedIdea: Keep database aggregate updates inside their existing SQLite transaction; commit visibility is scoped to that database, not an automatic atomic boundary spanning JSON files, UI tasks and image buffers.
references.limits: Do not replace the existing project transaction or add a distributed transaction framework without a demonstrated cross-store recovery gap.

references.appliedIdea: Bind retries to an operation identity and equivalent request parameters; validate before beginning side effects and distinguish retry from a deliberate new version.
references.limits: APIv1 andv2 have different retry/result policies; do not copy a24-hour payment-key retention rule into long-lived photography projects or claim unlimited exactly-once behavior.

references.appliedIdea: Event sources can extend listeners lifetimes. An owner must deliberately detach or use suitable weak-event support when the source outlives the view.
references.limits: Weak events address reference retention, not cancellation completion, epoch validity, save revision correctness or in-flight task draining.
